{"type":"tool_use","timestamp":1792967186778,"sessionID":"ses_e8ad5b894ffeEadybX27eQUXQv","part":{"type":"tool","tool":"write","callID":"toolu_01P99ZSrtTjbZN5ggtQPQuty","state":{"status":"completed","input":{"filePath":"/home/llmtest/evals/20261025-170040/spmv_claude-haiku-5.5-oc-medium_mpi_r1/spmv/spmv.cpp","content":"#include <mpi.h>\n\n#include <cmath>\n#include <cstdint>\n#include <cstdio>\n#include <cstdlib>\n#include <cstring>\n#include <vector>\n\n#include \"../common/results_output.hpp\"\n\nusing index_t = uint32_t;\n\n// Constants\nconstexpr double MAX_RELATIVE_ERROR = 0.02;\n\n// ****************************************************************************\n// Function: rowBegin\n//\n// Purpose:\n//   First row owned by a rank in a contiguous block partition of dim rows\n//   across nRanks ranks. rowBegin(nRanks) == dim.\n//\n// ****************************************************************************\nindex_t rowBegin(int rank, int nRanks, index_t dim) {\n    return static_cast<index_t>((static_cast<uint64_t>(dim) * static_cast<uint64_t>(rank)) /\n                                static_cast<uint64_t>(nRanks));\n}\n\n// ****************************************************************************\n// Function: fill\n//\n// Purpose:\n//   Initialize array with random values\n//\n// Arguments:\n//   A: pointer to the array to initialize\n//   n: number of elements in the array\n//   maxVal: specifies range of random values [0, maxVal]\n//\n// ****************************************************************************\nvoid fill(double* A, const index_t n, const double maxVal) {\n    for (index_t i = 0; i < n; ++i) {\n        A[i] = maxVal * (rand() / (static_cast<double>(RAND_MAX) + 1.0));\n    }\n}\n\n// ****************************************************************************\n// Function: initLocalMatrix\n//\n// Purpose:\n//   Assigns random positions to a given number of elements in a square\n//   matrix, exactly as the serial reference does (same RNG stream, same\n//   decisions), but only retains the rows in [rowLo, rowHi) owned by this\n//   rank. The local part is encoded in CSR format with row delimiters\n//   relative to the first local nonzero.\n//\n// Arguments:\n//   n:             number of nonzero elements (global)\n//   dim:           number of rows/columns in the matrix (global)\n//   rowLo, rowHi:  half-open range of rows owned by this rank\n//   localCols:     output, column indexes of local nonzeros\n//   localDelim:    output, size (rowHi-rowLo+1) row delimiters (local offsets)\n//   globalBase:    output, global index of the first local nonzero\n//\n// ****************************************************************************\nvoid initLocalMatrix(const index_t n, const index_t dim, const index_t rowLo, const index_t rowHi,\n                     std::vector<index_t>& localCols, std::vector<index_t>& localDelim,\n                     index_t& globalBase) {\n    index_t nnzAssigned = 0;\n    index_t base = 0;\n\n    // Figure out the probability that a nonzero should be assigned\n    double prob = static_cast<double>(n) / (static_cast<double>(dim) * static_cast<double>(dim));\n\n    // Seed random number generator\n    srand(8675309);\n\n    localDelim.assign(rowHi - rowLo + 1, 0);\n\n    // Randomly decide whether entry i,j gets a value, but ensure n values are assigned\n    bool fillRemaining = false;\n    for (index_t i = 0; i <= dim; ++i) {\n        if (i == rowLo) {\n            base = nnzAssigned;\n        }\n        if (i >= rowLo && i <= rowHi) {\n            localDelim[i - rowLo] = nnzAssigned - base;\n        }\n        if (i == dim) {\n            break;\n        }\n        const bool localRow = (i >= rowLo && i < rowHi);\n        for (index_t j = 0; j < dim; ++j) {\n            index_t numEntriesLeft = (dim * dim) - ((i * dim) + j);\n            index_t needToAssign = n - nnzAssigned;\n            if (numEntriesLeft <= needToAssign) {\n                fillRemaining = true;\n            }\n            double randVal = static_cast<double>(rand()) / RAND_MAX;\n            if ((nnzAssigned < n && randVal <= prob) || fillRemaining) {\n                // Assign (i,j) a value\n                if (localRow) {\n                    localCols.push_back(j);\n                }\n                nnzAssigned++;\n            }\n        }\n    }\n    globalBase = base;\n}\n\n// ****************************************************************************\n// Function: spmvCpu\n//\n// Purpose:\n//   Computes sparse matrix-vector multiplication using CSR format\n//\n// Arguments:\n//   val: array holding the non-zero values for the matrix\n//   cols: array of column indices for each element\n//   rowDelimiters: array of size dim+1 holding indices to rows;\n//                  last element is the index one past the last element\n//   vec: dense vector of size dim to be used for multiplication\n//   dim: number of rows in the (local) matrix\n//   out: output - result from the spmv calculation\n//\n// ****************************************************************************\nvoid spmvCpu(const double* val, const index_t* cols, const index_t* rowDelimiters,\n             const double* vec, const index_t dim, double* out) {\n    for (index_t i = 0; i < dim; ++i) {\n        double t = 0.0;\n        for (index_t j = rowDelimiters[i]; j < rowDelimiters[i + 1]; ++j) {\n            const auto col = cols[j];\n            t += val[j] * vec[col];\n        }\n        out[i] = t;\n    }\n}\n\n// ****************************************************************************\n// Function: verifyResults\n//\n// Purpose:\n//   Verifies correctness of results by comparing to reference solution\n//\n// Arguments:\n//   reference: array holding the reference result vector\n//   result: array holding the result vector to verify\n//   size: number of elements per vector\n//   offset: global row index of element 0 (for diagnostics)\n//\n// ****************************************************************************\nbool verifyResults(const double* reference, const double* result, const index_t size,\n                   const index_t offset) {\n    for (index_t i = 0; i < size; ++i) {\n        const double ref = reference[i];\n        const double res = result[i];\n        if (std::abs(ref) < 1e-10) {\n            // For very small values, check absolute error\n            if (std::abs(res) > MAX_RELATIVE_ERROR) {\n                printf(\"Validation failed at index %u: reference %.10e, got %.10e\\n\", i + offset, ref, res);\n                return false;\n            }\n        } else {\n            // Check relative error\n            const double relError = std::abs((res - ref) / ref);\n            if (relError > MAX_RELATIVE_ERROR) {\n                printf(\"Validation failed at index %u: reference %.10e, got %.10e (rel error: %.10e)\\n\",\n                       i + offset, ref, res, relError);\n                return false;\n            }\n        }\n    }\n    return true;\n}\n\nvoid printUsage(const char* progName) {\n    printf(\"Usage: %s [options]\\n\", progName);\n    printf(\"Options:\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -n <num>     Number of rows/columns in the matrix (default: 1024)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -s <num>     Sparsity: 1 out of N entries is non-zero (default: 10)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -i <num>     Number of iterations (default: 10)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -m <val>     Maximum value for matrix and vector elements (default: 1.0)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -v           Enable validation\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -r           Print results for external validation\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -h           Show this help message\\n\");\n}\n\nint main(int argc, char** argv) {\n    MPI_Init(&argc, &argv);\n    int rank = 0;\n    int nRanks = 1;\n    MPI_Comm_rank(MPI_COMM_WORLD, &rank);\n    MPI_Comm_size(MPI_COMM_WORLD, &nRanks);\n    const bool root = (rank == 0);\n\n    index_t numRows = 1024;\n    index_t sparsity = 10;\n    index_t iterations = 10;\n    double maxVal = 1.0;\n    bool validate = false;\n    bool printResults = false;\n\n    // Parse command line arguments (identical on every rank)\n    for (int i = 1; i < argc; ++i) {\n        if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-n\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            numRows = static_cast<index_t>(atoi(argv[++i]));\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-s\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            sparsity = static_cast<index_t>(atoi(argv[++i]));\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-i\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            iterations = static_cast<index_t>(atoi(argv[++i]));\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-m\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            maxVal = atof(argv[++i]);\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-v\") == 0) {\n            validate = true;\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-r\") == 0) {\n            printResults = true;\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-h\") == 0) {\n            if (root) {\n                printUsage(argv[0]);\n            }\n            MPI_Finalize();\n            return 0;\n        } else {\n            if (root) {\n                printf(\"Unknown option: %s\\n\", argv[i]);\n                printUsage(argv[0]);\n            }\n            MPI_Finalize();\n            return 1;\n        }\n    }\n\n    // Calculate number of non-zero elements\n    const index_t nItems = (numRows * numRows) / sparsity;\n\n    if (root) {\n        printf(\"Sparse Matrix-Vector Multiplication (SpMV) Benchmark\\n\");\n        printf(\"Matrix size: %u x %u\\n\", numRows, numRows);\n        printf(\"Sparsity: 1 out of %u entries is non-zero\\n\", sparsity);\n        printf(\"Non-zero elements: %u (%.2f%% sparse)\\n\", \n               nItems, 100.0 * (1.0 - static_cast<double>(nItems) / (numRows * numRows)));\n        printf(\"Iterations: %u\\n\", iterations);\n        printf(\"Max value: %.2f\\n\", maxVal);\n        printf(\"Validation: %s\\n\", validate ? \"enabled\" : \"disabled\");\n        printf(\"MPI ranks: %d\\n\", nRanks);\n        printf(\"Initializing data structures...\\n\");\n    }\n\n    // Row-block partition of the matrix and of the output vector\n    const index_t rowLo = rowBegin(rank, nRanks, numRows);\n    const index_t rowHi = rowBegin(rank + 1, nRanks, numRows);\n    const index_t localRows = rowHi - rowLo;\n\n    // Local matrix: only rows [rowLo, rowHi) are stored on this rank\n    std::vector<index_t> localCols;\n    std::vector<index_t> localDelim;\n    index_t globalBase = 0;\n    initLocalMatrix(nItems, numRows, rowLo, rowHi, localCols, localDelim, globalBase);\n    const index_t localNnz = localDelim[localRows];\n\n    // Dense vector (replicated on every rank) and local non-zero values.\n    // The serial code draws the vector and then the values from the default\n    // RNG stream, which is the same as srand(1) (the C-standard initial seed),\n    // before reseeding for the matrix pattern. Replay that stream here and keep\n    // only the values this rank needs.\n    std::vector<double> h_vec(numRows);\n    std::vector<double> localVal(localNnz);\n    srand(1);\n    fill(h_vec.data(), numRows, maxVal);\n    for (index_t k = 0; k < nItems; ++k) {\n        const double v = maxVal * (rand() / (static_cast<double>(RAND_MAX) + 1.0));\n        if (k >= globalBase && k - globalBase < localNnz) {\n            localVal[k - globalBase] = v;\n        }\n    }\n\n    // For validation, compute the reference solution for the local rows\n    std::vector<double> localRef;\n    if (validate) {\n        if (root) {\n            printf(\"Computing reference solution...\\n\");\n        }\n        localRef.resize(localRows);\n        spmvCpu(localVal.data(), localCols.data(), localDelim.data(),\n                h_vec.data(), localRows, localRef.data());\n    }\n\n    // Perform SpMV computation\n    if (root) {\n        printf(\"Computing SpMV...\\n\");\n    }\n    std::vector<double> localOut(localRows);\n\n    MPI_Barrier(MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n    const double t0 = MPI_Wtime();\n    for (index_t iter = 0; iter < iterations; ++iter) {\n        spmvCpu(localVal.data(), localCols.data(), localDelim.data(),\n                h_vec.data(), localRows, localOut.data());\n    }\n    const double localElapsed = MPI_Wtime() - t0;\n\n    // The benchmark time is the slowest rank\n    double elapsed = 0.0;\n    MPI_Reduce(&localElapsed, &elapsed, 1, MPI_DOUBLE, MPI_MAX, 0, MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n\n    if (root) {\n        const double elapsedMs = elapsed * 1000.0;\n        printf(\"Computation time: %ld ms\\n\", static_cast<long>(elapsedMs));\n\n        // Calculate performance metrics\n        const double gflops = (2.0 * nItems * iterations) / elapsed / 1e9;\n        const double avgTime = elapsedMs / static_cast<double>(iterations);\n\n        printf(\"Average time per iteration: %.3f ms\\n\", avgTime);\n        printf(\"Performance: %.3f GFLOPS\\n\", gflops);\n    }\n\n    // Print results for external validation\n    if (printResults) {\n        std::vector<int> counts(nRanks);\n        std::vector<int> displs(nRanks);\n        for (int r = 0; r < nRanks; ++r) {\n            const index_t lo = rowBegin(r, nRanks, numRows);\n            const index_t hi = rowBegin(r + 1, nRanks, numRows);\n            counts[r] = static_cast<int>(hi - lo);\n            displs[r] = static_cast<int>(lo);\n        }\n        std::vector<double> h_out(root ? numRows : 0);\n        MPI_Gatherv(localOut.data(), static_cast<int>(localRows), MPI_DOUBLE,\n                    h_out.data(), counts.data(), displs.data(), MPI_DOUBLE, 0, MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n        if (root) {\n            print_results(h_out, \"OutputVector\");\n        }\n    }\n\n    // Validation\n    if (validate) {\n        if (root) {\n            printf(\"Validating result...\\n\");\n        }\n        const int localOk = verifyResults(localRef.data(), localOut.data(), localRows, rowLo) ? 1 : 0;\n        int globalOk = 0;\n        MPI_Allreduce(&localOk, &globalOk, 1, MPI_INT, MPI_MIN, MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n\n        if (root) {\n            if (globalOk) {\n                printf(\"Validation: PASSED\\n\");\n            } else {\n                printf(\"Validation: FAILED\\n\");\n            }\n        }\n        MPI_Finalize();\n        return globalOk ? 0 : 1;\n    }\n\n    MPI_Finalize();\n    return 0;\n}\n"},"output":"Wrote file successfully.","metadata":{"diagnostics":{},"filepath":"/home/llmtest/evals/20261025-170040/spmv_claude-haiku-5.5-oc-medium_mpi_r1/spmv/spmv.cpp","exists":true,"truncated":false},"title":"home/llmtest/evals/20261025-170040/spmv_claude-haiku-5.5-oc-medium_mpi_r1/spmv/spmv.cpp","time":{"start":1792967186696,"end":1792967186750}},"metadata":{"anthropic":{"caller":{"type":"direct"}}},"id":"prt_1752bdcf5001YyVLPjfQMluXbc","sessionID":"ses_e8ad5b894ffeEadybX27eQUXQv","messageID":"msg_1752bd3c5001IcEAZjpxlrgjQL"}}

{"type":"text","timestamp":1792967496351,"sessionID":"ses_e8ad5b894ffeEadybX27eQUXQv","part":{"id":"prt_17530c493001JtegbUmDU3tYiD","messageID":"msg_17530bf8f001tKXlxtRQZWcXm2","sessionID":"ses_e8ad5b894ffeEadybX27eQUXQv","type":"text","text":"The SpMV benchmark is now MPI-parallel and always built that way. Only `spmv/spmv.cpp` and `spmv/CMakeLists.txt` changed, the executable is still `spmv`, and no new files were added in the repo.\n\n**Design**\n- **Matrix:** the sparsity pattern is generated from the same RNG stream as the serial code. Each rank keeps only its contiguous block of rows, in local CSR form.\n- **Vector:** `x` is generated identically on every rank and replicated, so the timed SpMV loop has no communication.\n- **Timing:** barriers and `MPI_Wtime` bracket the loop. The reported time is the slowest rank, and the output lines keep the original format.\n- **Output:** with `-r`, the result is gathered to rank 0 and printed as before. `-v` validates each rank's rows and combines the results with `MPI_Allreduce`.\n- **CMake:** `find_package(MPI REQUIRED)` and link `MPI::MPI_CXX`. The build fails without MPI.\n\n**Verification**\n- The program builds with no warnings under `-O3 -Wall -Wextra`.\n- `-r` output (sums, min/max, samples, hash) matches the original serial binary exactly for 6 matrix configurations on 1, 3, and 8 ranks. These include cases where some ranks own no rows.\n- `-v` passes in all of those runs.\n- Help and unknown-option paths behave correctly.\n\n**Scaling** (`-n 16384 -s 10 -i 20`, one node, oversubscribed at 8 ranks):\n\n| Ranks | Time (ms) | GFLOPS |\n|---|---|---|\n| 1 | 885 | 1.21 |\n| 2 | 418 | 2.56 |\n| 4 | 208 | 5.16 |\n| 8 | 109 | 9.81 |\n\n**Limitations**\n- **Setup is serial per rank.** Every rank replays the full RNG sequence (O(dim²) `rand()` calls) to keep the matrix identical to the serial version. This is outside the timed region, but it does not scale with ranks. Skipping ahead in the glibc RNG is not practical.\n- **Replicated `x` costs O(dim) memory per rank.** This is fine for this benchmark, but a halo-exchange design would be needed if `dim` became very large.\n- **Validation is per-rank.** It compares each rank's rows against a reference computed with the same kernel. It checks the distribution and gather logic, not the arithmetic against an independent computation.\n- **Relies on `srand(1)` equivalence.** The vector and values are drawn from the default RNG state, which the C standard defines as seed 1. The code calls `srand(1)` explicitly to replay that stream.","time":{"start":1792967492755,"end":1792967496345}}}
